data.notes: ADE 2027 official dates/program were not yet publicly confirmed in the sources checked, so the verified October 2027 calendar is currently led by arena-scale Dutch pop/rock, tribute-rock, and electronic-orchestral shows.

events.title: Racoon: 30 jaar Racoon
events.summary: Racoon marks its 30th anniversary with two Ziggo Dome shows on Friday 1 and Saturday 2 October 2027, covering Dutch and English-language hits plus newer material. The venue page lists the shows as sold out.

events.title: SYNTHONY
events.summary: SYNTHONY plays AFAS Live on 16 October 2027, bringing its orchestral dance/electronic concert format to Amsterdam.

events.title: 20 JAAR 3JS
events.summary: Dutch pop band 3JS closes its 20th-anniversary celebration with a special AFAS Live show featuring an expanded band and guest appearances including Jan Smit.

events.title: Brit Floyd: ANIMALS 50 – World Tour 2027
events.summary: Brit Floyd brings its Animals 50 production to AFAS Live, performing Pink Floyd’s Animals material with a large-scale visual and laser production plus catalogue favourites.

events.title: Brit Floyd: Echoes - 60 Years of Pink Floyd
events.summary: Brit Floyd adds a second AFAS Live date with Echoes - 60 Years of Pink Floyd, a separate show focused on six decades of Pink Floyd repertoire.
